newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Sierra Leone students call pro-democracy marches.
newsitem.headline: Sierra Leone students call pro-democracy marches.

text.p: Sierra Leone's National Union of Students has called for pro-democracy marches in Freetown and other towns on Monday and invited labour unions and professional bodies to take part, student officials said.

They said the military government that seized power in Sierra Leone on May 25 had retaliated by ordering students off campus. The government has also threatened to deploy extra forces to stop marches going ahead.
The students want the military to hand back power to ousted civilian president Ahmad Tejan Kabbah.
